answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents stake tokens into a cryptographic attestation chain verified by zero-knowledge proofs. Each duplicate identity scales verification bonding superlinearly (O(2^n)), imposing exponential capital exhaustion for Sybil swarms. Cheap imitation is a fable: fraudulent nodes trying to pool resources across a staking lagoon face slashing, ensuring honest consensus remains defended upon a secure stake knoll.
